hints.title: Monotonic Capacity Search
hints.text: The total number of tasks that can be completed satisfies a monotonic feasibility property.

hints.title: Easiest Tasks and Strongest Workers
hints.text: To verify feasibility for k tasks, select the k smallest tasks and pair them with the k strongest workers.

hints.title: Greedy Pill Distribution
hints.text: Assign tasks from hardest to easiest, using natural strength when possible or giving pills to the weakest eligible worker.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log(min(N, M)) * K log K) binary search on task capacity
complexity.space: O(K) deque tracking available eligible workers
complexity.notes: For candidate k, test the k easiest tasks with the k strongest workers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy task assignment without binary search on the total achievable count fails due to pill tradeoffs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic feasibility allows logarithmic search over the answer range [0, min(N, M)].
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that testing feasibility for k tasks is monotonic.
